subjects: an original anime-inspired maintainer and a small friendly robot companion
price, supply, and runtime evidence becoming one inspectable route recommendation
a clean decision board that makes policy trade-offs visible without becoming a provider dashboard
composition: recurring maintainer and robot keep visual continuity across assets
wide negative space for exact title and subtitle copy
main characters and decision path remain visible at narrow crops
simple route cards and symbols explain the mechanism without dense microcopy
style: Original anime-inspired editorial product illustration with cinematic blue-violet evening light, cyan glass signals, coral price accents, warm gold recommendations, and clean case-study composition.
text_policy: Narrative PNG assets carry one exact title and one exact subtitle supplied verbatim in the prompt. Incidental prop lettering is not relied on. No technical diagram should replace the narrative asset.
reject_when: the human and robot relationship is missing or obscured
the title or subtitle changes, becomes unreadable, or is replaced with generic text
the visual looks like a provider dashboard or implies live guarantees
the route comparison hides the difference between sparse cheap supply and well-supplied higher cost
multiple focal points compete with the explanation
the image falls back to a generic mountain, stock, cyberpunk, or abstract network scene
